import os,pathlib,json,subprocess,re,shutil,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server')
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
def run(a,t=8):return subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t)
def prop(k):return run(['systemctl','show',svc,'--property='+k,'--value']).stdout.strip()
r={'scope':'Jellyfin service binding and synthetic A/V verification only','active':prop('ActiveState'),'service_user':prop('User'),'uid':os.geteuid(),'changed':False}
paths={}
pid=int(prop('MainPID') or '0')
allowed={'--datadir','--configdir','--cachedir','--logdir','--ffmpeg','--ffmpeg-path','--webdir'}
try:
 a=pathlib.Path('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/cmdline').read_bytes().decode(errors='replace').split(chr(0))
 for i,v in enumerate(a):
  if v in allowed and i+1<len(a) and a[i+1].startswith('/'):paths[v]=a[i+1]
  elif '=' in v and v.split('=',1)[0] in allowed and v.split('=',1)[1].startswith('/'):paths[v.split('=',1)[0]]=v.split('=',1)[1]
except OSError:r['process_args_readable']=False
r['runtime_path_flags']=paths
r['unit_fragment']=prop('FragmentPath')
r['unit_working_directory']=prop('WorkingDirectory')
r['root_dirs']=[p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()][:30]
cfg=[]
for p in [root/'config'/'encoding.xml',root/'data'/'config'/'encoding.xml',root/'data'/'encoding.xml',pathlib.Path(paths.get('--configdir',str(root/'config')))/'encoding.xml']:
 if p in [x['path'] for x in cfg] or not p.is_file():continue
 try:
  e=ET.parse(p).getroot()
  fields={}
  for x in e.iter():
   key=x.tag.split('}')[-1]
   if key in ('EncoderAppPath','EncoderAppPathDisplay','FFmpegPath','TranscodingTempPath','EnableHardwareEncoding','HardwareAccelerationType','EncodingThreadCount'):fields[key]=x.text
  cfg.append({'path':str(p),'fields':fields})
 except (OSError,ET.ParseError):pass
r['encoding_xml']=cfg
journal=run(['journalctl','-u',svc,'-n','2500','--no-pager','-o','cat'],10)
lines=journal.stdout.splitlines()
r['journal_read_exit']=journal.returncode
r['ffmpeg_log_summary']={'ffmpeg_mentions':sum('ffmpeg' in l.lower() for l in lines),'encoder_errors':sum(bool(re.search(r'(ffmpeg|encoder).{0,100}(not found|failed|invalid|permission denied|does not exist)',l,re.I)) for l in lines)}
r['observed_ffmpeg_paths']=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/(?:usr|srv|opt)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+/ffmpeg(?=[\s"\x27,:;]|$)','\n'.join(lines))))[:10]
r['observed_ffmpeg_versions']=sorted(set(re.findall(r'ffmpeg version [0-9][A-Za-z0-9.+~-]*','\n'.join(lines),re.I)))[:8]
u=r['service_user']
prefix=[] if u and os.geteuid()==__import__('pwd').getpwnam(u).pw_uid else ['sudo','-n','-u',u,'--']
if u:
 t=run(prefix+['/usr/bin/ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-nostdin','-loglevel','error','-f','lavfi','-i','testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25','-f','lavfi','-i','sine=frequency=650:sample_rate=48000','-t','2','-c:v','libx264','-threads','1','-c:a','aac','-f','null','-'],15)
 r['service_identity_encode_exit']=t.returncode
 r['service_identity_test_pass']=t.returncode==0
print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
